metadata.description: Runlease, built by the Marshal team: disposable cloud machines for coding agents, in your own Google Cloud or AWS account, at spot prices.

plugins.name: runlease
plugins.description: Give Claude Code a real cloud machine when the task outgrows your laptop: long builds, code you would not run locally, test runs split across machines. Spot VMs in your own Google Cloud or AWS account, with a live view of each lease and its cost. Every machine deletes itself when its lease ends. Built by the Marshal team.
